about.heading:
A Voice For
The Late Set
about.leadText: Singing silky smooth, sweet, and sometimes a wee bit sticky.
paragraphs: Based on Vancouver Island, Mel McCutcheon has become a fixture of the region's jazz rooms, a voice that moves easily between the warmth of a big band and the intimacy of a quartet.
She currently fronts three different Vancouver Island ensembles, each built for a different room, a different band, the same unmistakable voice.

items.name: The Sharp Seven
items.description:
The Sharp Seven is a well-established jazz ensemble with a long-standing history in the Comox Valley. Fronted by Mel McCutcheon, the group brings together a talented collection of musicians whose individual styles and musical experience blend to create a lively and engaging jazz sound.

Mel's warm, expressive vocals complement the band's rich instrumental arrangements, weaving together with the horns, piano and rhythm section to bring classic jazz favourites and swinging standards to life.

The current lineup features Paul Nuez on trombone, Grahame Edwards on bass, Michelle Draper on piano, Jack Reynolds on saxophone and flute, Beau Stocker on drums, and Dave Lymburner on trumpet.

Their repertoire ranges from timeless jazz standards and swing to blues, Latin rhythms and big-band favourites. With an easy musical rapport, lively interplay and a shared love of performing, The Sharp Seven continues to delight audiences throughout the Comox Valley and beyond.

items.name: Mel McCutcheon Ensembles
items.description: Mel McCutcheon performs in a variety of musical settings, from intimate duos and trios to full quartets. These smaller ensembles are well suited to private events, cocktail receptions, elegant dinners, and special celebrations. Whether providing a subtle musical backdrop or stepping into the spotlight, Mel brings together the right combination of musicians and music to suit the occasion.

items.name: Vintage Velvet
items.description: A quintet built around Mel's soulful, Vaughan- and Simone-inflected side. Late nights, low light.

items.quote: And then came The Mel McCutcheon Quartet. Absolutely incredible. A timeless journey from start to finish. The four of them play so well together. Mel herself is magnetic. Her beauty is the first thing you notice, but it’s her warmth, her wit, and the passion behind her voice that keeps you captivated. She doesn’t just sing, she tells a story, and you feel every word.
items.name: Tamsyn

items.quote: Mel McCutcheon’s voice was absolutely stunning, rich with emotion and clarity, floating effortlessly above the room. The guitar, bass, and drums complemented her perfectly, each musician adding depth and texture while weaving together a sound that wrapped around the audience like a comforting embrace. It was an afternoon of pure musical artistry and heart.
items.name: Kristi W.

items.quote: The music was absolutely amazing, and Mel’s performance was outstanding. She brought so much energy and heart to the stage. The entire show was beautifully done from start to finish. It was a memorable experience, and we’re so glad we were there. Highly recommend!
items.name: Ofri L.

items.quote: Polished, relaxed and full of energy.

items.quote: Very enjoyable event at Painters Lodge with Beau Stocker and Co. Mel’s vocals and her backup were excellent… nothing compares with years of experience working together!

items.quote: We enjoyed a fabulous lunch at Painters Lodge with swinging Jazz accompaniment by The Sharp Seven group of very talented musicians. What a lovely setting for this great event on Valentine’s Day!
